Thank you for coming to the talk. Do you work here at the bank?
Yes, I do. I’m a product designer. I lead a team of six designers.
Nice to meet you. I’m Daniel. I run a design team at a payments company in Chicago. What do you design here?
We design the credit card features of the app. I’m in charge of the logic behind the screens, not only the screens.
So you think about the whole flow. That’s the hard part. And you work with a lot of stakeholders, I imagine.
A lot! The tech lead, the product team, the business heads. We need to align every week.
Same in my company. These days we’re testing AI tools in every project, and everybody has an opinion. What are you working on at the moment?
At the moment we’re rolling out a new feature for our users, and the deadline is next month.
Good luck with that. I’m in São Paulo until Friday for a design conference. Let’s keep in touch.

Hi, I'm Oliver. I'm a product designer at a small bank in London, in the mobile app team. My week is quite regular. On Mondays I usually meet the stakeholders and we plan the week. On Tuesdays and Wednesdays I design, and on Thursdays we test with real users. I don't work on Fridays, because I work four days a week. But this month is different. At the moment we're designing a new flow to open an account in five minutes, and the deadline is very close. So these days I'm working on Fridays too, and I'm drinking a lot of coffee.

Hello, I'm Priya, and I'm a product manager at a fintech company in Bangalore. People often ask me what I actually do. Well, I don't design and I don't write code. I work with a designer and a tech lead every day, and together we decide what the team builds first and what waits. I talk to users, I read the data, and I protect the deadline. At the moment we're rolling out a new payment feature. We're giving it to a small group of users first, and we're watching the numbers every morning. If the numbers are good, we open it to everybody next month.
